<USER>User story: "As a user, I want to log in with valid credentials so I can access my dashboard."
Category: authentication

<ASSISTANT>import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

test.describe('User Login with Valid Credentials', () => {
  test.beforeEach(async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto('/login');
  });

  test('should successfully log in with valid credentials and redirect to dashboard', async ({ page }) => {
    // Listen for the login API call
    await page.route('**/api/auth/login', (route) => {
      route.continue();
    });

    // Locate and fill email input using getByLabel
    const emailInput = page.getByLabel('Email');
    await expect(emailInput).toBeVisible();
    await emailInput.fill('user@example.com');

    // Locate and fill password input using getByLabel
    const passwordInput = page.getByLabel('Password');
    await expect(passwordInput).toBeVisible();
    await passwordInput.fill('ValidPassword123!');

    // Click login button using getByRole
    const loginButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: /log in/i });
    await expect(loginButton).toBeVisible();
    await loginButton.click();

    // Wait for navigation and verify dashboard content
    await page.waitForURL('/dashboard');
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/.*dashboard/);

    // Verify welcome message using getByRole for heading
    const welcomeHeading = page.getByRole('heading', { name: /welcome back/i });
    await expect(welcomeHeading).toBeVisible();
    await expect(welcomeHeading).toContainText('Welcome back');

    // Verify user profile icon and logout button
    const profileIcon = page.getByRole('img', { name: /user profile/i });
    await expect(profileIcon).toBeVisible();

    const logoutButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: /log out/i });
    await expect(logoutButton).toBeVisible();
  });

  test('should display error message when login fails with invalid credentials', async ({ page }) => {
    // Mock failed login response
    await page.route('**/api/auth/login', (route) => {
      route.abort('failed');
    });

    // Locate and fill email input using getByLabel
    const emailInput = page.getByLabel('Email');
    await emailInput.fill('user@example.com');

    // Locate and fill password input using getByLabel
    const passwordInput = page.getByLabel('Password');
    await passwordInput.fill('WrongPassword123!');

    // Click login button using getByRole
    const loginButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: /log in/i });
    await loginButton.click();

    // Wait for error message to appear
    const errorMessage = page.getByText(/invalid email or password/i);
    await expect(errorMessage).toBeVisible();
    await expect(errorMessage).toContainText('Invalid email or password');

    // Verify still on login page
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/.*login/);

    // Verify form fields retain values
    await expect(emailInput).toHaveValue('user@example.com');
    await expect(passwordInput).toHaveValue('WrongPassword123!');

    // Verify dashboard content is not visible
    const welcomeMessage = page.getByRole('heading', { name: /welcome back/i });
    await expect(welcomeMessage).not.toBeVisible();
  });
});</ASSISTANT>

test.describe('Authentication - Protected Page Redirect', () => {
  test.beforeEach(async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto('/dashboard');
  });

  test('should redirect unauthenticated user to login when accessing protected page', async ({ page }) => {
    // Clear all cookies and storage to ensure unauthenticated state
    await page.context().clearCookies();
    await page.evaluate(() => localStorage.clear());
    await page.evaluate(() => sessionStorage.clear());

    // Attempt to visit protected dashboard page
    await page.goto('/dashboard', { waitUntil: 'networkidle' });

    // Verify redirect to login page occurred
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/login/);

    // Verify login form is visible
    const loginForm = page.getByRole('form');
    await expect(loginForm).toBeVisible();

    // Verify login button exists and is enabled
    const loginButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: /login|sign in/i });
    await expect(loginButton).toBeVisible();
    await expect(loginButton).toBeEnabled();

    // Verify email input field is present and can be located by label
    const emailInput = page.getByLabel(/email|username/i);
    await expect(emailInput).toBeVisible();

    // Verify password input field is present and can be located by label
    const passwordInput = page.getByLabel(/password/i);
    await expect(passwordInput).toBeVisible();

    // Verify form title or heading contains login text
    const formTitle = page.getByRole('heading', { name: /login|sign in/i });
    await expect(formTitle).toBeVisible();
  });

  test('should handle rapid redirect attempts and prevent infinite loops', async ({ page }) => {
    // Clear authentication state
    await page.context().clearCookies();
    await page.evaluate(() => localStorage.clear());
    await page.evaluate(() => sessionStorage.clear());

    // Setup API intercept for auth verification
    await page.route('**/api/auth/verify', (route) => {
      route.abort('blockedbyclient');
    });

    // Attempt to access protected resource
    await page.goto('/dashboard', { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });

    // Verify we're on login page after first attempt
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/login/);

    // Verify login form is present using role-based selector
    const emailInput = page.getByLabel(/email|username/i);
    await expect(emailInput).toBeVisible();

    // Try accessing another protected page
    await page.goto('/profile', { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });

    // Should still be on login, not in redirect loop
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/login/);

    // Verify no error message indicating redirect loop
    const errorMessage = page.getByRole('alert');
    await expect(errorMessage).toHaveCount(0);

    // Verify login button is still available and enabled
    const loginButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: /login|sign in/i });
    await expect(loginButton).toBeVisible();
    await expect(loginButton).toBeEnabled();

    // Verify form is still functional by filling it
    const passwordInput = page.getByLabel(/password/i);
    await emailInput.fill('test@example.com');
    await passwordInput.fill('password123');

    // Verify form submission button is available
    await expect(loginButton).toBeVisible();
  });
});</ASSISTANT>

Category: authentication

<ASSISTANT>import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

test.describe('Remember Me Checkbox - Authentication', () => {
  test.beforeEach(async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto('/login');
    await page.context().clearCookies();
    await page.evaluate(() => localStorage.clear());
  });

  test('should persist user session when Remember Me is checked', async ({ page }) => {
    // Fill login form
    const emailField = page.getByLabel('Email Address');
    const passwordField = page.getByLabel('Password');
    const rememberMeCheckbox = page.getByRole('checkbox', { name: /remember me/i });
    const loginButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: /sign in|login/i });
    
    await emailField.fill('testuser@example.com');
    await passwordField.fill('securePassword123');
    
    // Check Remember Me checkbox
    await rememberMeCheckbox.click();
    await expect(rememberMeCheckbox).toBeChecked();
    
    // Intercept login API call
    const loginPromise = page.waitForResponse(response => 
      response.url().includes('/api/auth/login') && response.status() === 200
    );
    
    // Submit login form
    await loginButton.click();
    const response = await loginPromise;
    const responseBody = await response.json();
    expect(responseBody.rememberMeEnabled).toBe(true);
    
    // Verify redirect to dashboard
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/dashboard/);
    
    // Verify session token is stored
    const sessionToken = await page.evaluate(() => localStorage.getItem('sessionToken'));
    expect(sessionToken).toBeTruthy();
    const rememberMeToken = await page.evaluate(() => localStorage.getItem('rememberMeToken'));
    expect(rememberMeToken).toBeTruthy();
    
    // Verify welcome message appears
    const welcomeMessage = page.getByText(/welcome/i);
    await expect(welcomeMessage).toBeVisible();
    
    // Verify user profile is accessible
    const profileMenu = page.getByRole('button', { name: /profile|account/i });
    await expect(profileMenu).toBeVisible();
  });

  test('should not persist session when Remember Me is unchecked', async ({ page }) => {
    // Fill login form without checking Remember Me
    const emailField = page.getByLabel('Email Address');
    const passwordField = page.getByLabel('Password');
    const rememberMeCheckbox = page.getByRole('checkbox', { name: /remember me/i });
    const loginButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: /sign in|login/i });
    
    await emailField.fill('testuser@example.com');
    await passwordField.fill('securePassword123');
    
    // Verify Remember Me is unchecked by default
    await expect(rememberMeCheckbox).not.toBeChecked();
    
    // Intercept and verify login request
    const loginPromise = page.waitForResponse(response =>
      response.url().includes('/api/auth/login') && response.status() === 200
    );
    
    // Submit login form
    await loginButton.click();
    const response = await loginPromise;
    const responseBody = await response.json();
    expect(responseBody.rememberMeEnabled).toBe(false);
    
    // Verify successful login
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/dashboard/);
    const welcomeText = page.getByText(/welcome/i);
    await expect(welcomeText).toBeVisible();
    
    // Simulate session expiration by clearing storage
    await page.evaluate(() => {
      localStorage.clear();
      sessionStorage.clear();
    });
    
    // Clear cookies to fully simulate session end
    await page.context().clearCookies();
    
    // Navigate to dashboard
    await page.goto('/dashboard');
    
    // Should be redirected to login page
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/login/);
    
    // Verify session expired message
    const sessionExpiredMsg = page.getByText(/session expired|login again/i);
    await expect(sessionExpiredMsg).toBeVisible();
  });
});</ASSISTANT>

test.describe('Login Loading Spinner', () => {
  test.beforeEach(async ({ page }) => {

  });

  test('should display loading spinner while login request is processing', async ({ page }) => {
    await page.route('**/api/auth/login', async (route) => {
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 2000));
      await route.abort();
      await route.continue();

      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 2000));

    await expect(spinner).toBeVisible();

    const spinnerText = page.getByText('Logging in...');
    await expect(spinnerText).toBeVisible();

    await page.waitForNavigation();
    await expect(spinner).not.toBeVisible();
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/.*dashboard/);
  });

  test('should hide spinner and display error message on failed login request', async ({ page }) => {

    const passwordInput = page.getByLabel('Password');

    const loginButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Login' });
    await loginButton.click();

    const spinner = page.locator('[data-testid="loading-spinner"]');
    await expect(spinner).toBeVisible();

    await page.waitForTimeout(1500);

    await expect(spinner).not.toBeVisible();

    const errorMessage = page.getByText('Invalid credentials');
    await expect(errorMessage).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/.*login/);
  });
});</ASSISTANT>

test.describe('Data Auto-Refresh After Mutation', () => {
  test.beforeEach(async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto('/dashboard');
  });

  test('should automatically refresh data display after successful mutation', async ({ page }) => {
    // Intercept and respond to initial GET request
    await page.route('/api/items', (route) => {
      route.continue();
    });

    // Verify initial data is visible
    const itemList = page.getByTestId('item-list');
    await expect(itemList).toBeVisible();
    const itemCount = page.getByTestId('item-count');
    await expect(itemCount).toContainText('5');

    // Setup intercept for mutation POST request
    await page.route('**/api/items', (route) => {
      if (route.request().method() === 'POST') {
        route.abort();
        route.continue();
      }
    });

    // Setup intercept for refresh GET request
    let refreshCount = 0;
    await page.route('/api/items', (route) => {
      if (route.request().method() === 'GET') {
        refreshCount++;
        if (refreshCount === 2) {
          route.fulfill({
            status: 200,
            body: JSON.stringify([
              { id: 1, name: 'Item 1' },
              { id: 2, name: 'Item 2' },
              { id: 3, name: 'Item 3' },
              { id: 4, name: 'Item 4' },
              { id: 5, name: 'Item 5' },
              { id: 6, name: 'New Item' },
            ]),
          });
        } else {
          route.continue();
        }
      }
    });

    // Perform mutation
    const addButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: /add item/i });
    await addButton.click();
    const itemInput = page.getByLabel(/item name/i);
    await itemInput.fill('New Item');
    const submitButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: /submit/i });
    await submitButton.click();

    // Wait for data to refresh
    await page.waitForTimeout(500);

    // Verify refreshed data
    await expect(itemCount).toContainText('6');
    await expect(itemList).toContainText('New Item');
  });

  test('should handle failed mutation and not refresh data', async ({ page }) => {
    // Verify initial data
    const itemCount = page.getByTestId('item-count');
    await expect(itemCount).toContainText('5');

    // Setup intercept for failed mutation
    await page.route('**/api/items', (route) => {
      if (route.request().method() === 'POST') {
        route.fulfill({
          status: 500,
          body: JSON.stringify({ error: 'Server error' }),
        });
      } else {
        route.continue();
      }
    });

    // Attempt mutation
    const addButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: /add item/i });
    await addButton.click();
    const itemInput = page.getByLabel(/item name/i);
    await itemInput.fill('Invalid Item');
    const submitButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: /submit/i });
    await submitButton.click();

    // Wait for error handling
    await page.waitForTimeout(500);

    // Verify error message is displayed
    const errorMessage = page.getByTestId('error-message');
    await expect(errorMessage).toBeVisible();
    await expect(errorMessage).toContainText('Server error');

    // Verify data hasn't been refreshed
    await expect(itemCount).toContainText('5');
    const itemList = page.getByTestId('item-list');
    await expect(itemList).not.toContainText('Invalid Item');
  });
});</ASSISTANT>

    // First save attempt fails with 409

    );

test.describe('Reorder List Items by Drag and Drop', () => {

    // Verify initial list order

    await expect(listItems).toHaveCount(3);
    await expect(listItems.nth(0)).toContainText('Item 1');
    await expect(listItems.nth(1)).toContainText('Item 2');

    );

    const targetItem = page.locator('[data-testid="list-item"]').nth(0);

    // Wait for API response
    await reorderPromise;

    // Verify new order
    await expect(listItems.nth(0)).toContainText('Item 3');
    await expect(listItems.nth(1)).toContainText('Item 1');
    await expect(listItems.nth(2)).toContainText('Item 2');

    // Verify success message using getByRole
    const successMessage = page.getByRole('status');
    await expect(successMessage).toBeVisible();
    await expect(successMessage).toContainText('List reordered successfully');
  });

  test('should not allow dragging when list is empty or single item exists', async ({ page }) => {
    // Navigate to empty list using getByRole
    const listSelector = page.getByRole('combobox', { name: 'List' });
    await listSelector.click();
    const emptyListOption = page.getByLabel('Empty List');
    await emptyListOption.click();

    // Verify drag handles are not visible
    const dragHandles = page.locator('[data-testid="list-item-drag-handle"]');
    await expect(dragHandles).toHaveCount(0);

    // Navigate to single item list using getByRole
    await listSelector.click();
    const singleItemOption = page.getByLabel('Single Item List');
    await singleItemOption.click();

    // Verify only one item exists
    const listItems = page.locator('[data-testid="list-item"]');
    await expect(listItems).toHaveCount(1);

    // Verify drag handle is disabled or not present
    const singleDragHandle = page.locator('[data-testid="list-item-drag-handle"]').first();
    const isDisabled = await singleDragHandle.isDisabled().catch(() => false);
    const exists = await singleDragHandle.isVisible().catch(() => false);

    if (exists) {
      await expect(singleDragHandle).toBeDisabled();
    } else {
      await expect(singleDragHandle).not.toBeVisible();
    }

    // Verify no reorder API call occurs
    let reorderCalled = false;
    page.on('response', response => {
      if (response.url().includes('/api/lists/reorder')) {
        reorderCalled = true;
      }
    });

    // Attempt drag operation
    const dragHandle = page.locator('[data-testid="list-item-drag-handle"]').first();
    if (await dragHandle.isVisible()) {
      await dragHandle.dragTo(dragHandle);
    }

    // Verify no API call was made
    await page.waitForTimeout(500);
    expect(reorderCalled).toBe(false);
  });
});</ASSISTANT>

    });

    await page.route('**/api/payment/process', route => {
      route.continue();
    }, { times: 0 });

    await page.route('**/api/payment/process', async route => {
      await route.abort();
    });

    // Use intercept pattern for Playwright
    await page.route('**/api/payment/process', route => {
      route.fulfill({
        status: 402,
        body: JSON.stringify({
          success: false,
          error: 'card_declined',
          message: 'Your card has been declined. Please check your card details and try again.'
        })
      });

    // Verify user stays on checkout page
    expect(page.url()).toContain('/checkout');

    // Verify button is re-enabled
    await expect(submitButton).toBeEnabled();
  });

    // First attempt - fill card details
    const cardNumberInput = page.getByLabel(/card number/i);
    await cardNumberInput.fill('4000000000000002');

    const expiryInput = page.getByLabel(/expiration date/i);

          body: JSON.stringify({

            error: 'card_declined',
            message: 'Your card has been declined.'
          })

          })

Category: async_await

<ASSISTANT>import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

test.describe('Login Spinner During Async Request', () => {
  test.beforeEach(async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto('/login');
  });

  test('should display spinner while login request is in progress', async ({ page }) => {
    // Intercept the login API to simulate delay
    await page.route('**/api/auth/login', async (route) => {
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 2000));
      await route.abort('failed');
      await route.continue();
    });

    // Enter email credentials using getByLabel
    const emailField = page.getByLabel('Email');
    await emailField.fill('user@example.com');
    expect(emailField).toHaveValue('user@example.com');

    // Enter password credentials using getByLabel
    const passwordField = page.getByLabel('Password');
    await passwordField.fill('password123');

    // Click login button using getByRole
    const loginButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: /login/i });
    await loginButton.click();

    // Verify spinner is visible immediately after clicking
    const spinner = page.locator('[data-testid="spinner"]');
    await expect(spinner).toBeVisible();

    // Verify spinner text using getByText
    const spinnerText = page.getByText('Logging in...');
    await expect(spinnerText).toBeVisible();

    // Verify login button is disabled during request
    await expect(loginButton).toBeDisabled();

    // Wait for potential navigation or spinner removal with timeout
    await page.waitForTimeout(2500);

    // Verify spinner disappears after request completes or delays
    const spinnerAfter = page.locator('[data-testid="spinner"]');
    const exists = await spinnerAfter.isVisible().catch(() => false);
    if (!exists) {
      await expect(spinnerAfter).not.toBeVisible();
    }

    // Verify login button is re-enabled or page state changes
    await expect(loginButton).not.toBeDisabled();
  });

  test('should hide spinner and show error when login request fails', async ({ page }) => {
    // Intercept the login API to simulate failure
    await page.route('**/api/auth/login', (route) => {
      route.abort('failed');
    });

    // Enter invalid email using getByLabel
    const emailField = page.getByLabel('Email');
    await emailField.fill('user@example.com');

    // Enter invalid password using getByLabel
    const passwordField = page.getByLabel('Password');
    await passwordField.fill('wrongpassword');

    // Click login button using getByRole
    const loginButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: /login/i });
    await loginButton.click();

    // Verify spinner is visible
    const spinner = page.locator('[data-testid="spinner"]');
    await expect(spinner).toBeVisible();

    // Wait for error state
    await page.waitForTimeout(1000);

    // Verify spinner is hidden after failure
    const spinnerRemoved = page.locator('[data-testid="spinner"]');
    const isVisible = await spinnerRemoved.isVisible().catch(() => false);
    if (!isVisible) {
      await expect(spinnerRemoved).not.toBeVisible();
    }

    // Verify error message is displayed using getByText
    const errorMessage = page.getByText('Invalid credentials');
    const errorExists = await errorMessage.isVisible().catch(() => false);
    if (errorExists) {
      await expect(errorMessage).toBeVisible();
    }

    // Verify login button is re-enabled for retry
    await expect(loginButton).not.toBeDisabled();

    // Verify user is still on login page
    expect(page.url()).toContain('/login');
  });
});</ASSISTANT>

<ASSISTANT>import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

test.describe('Async Data Fetching Non-Blocking Page Render', () => {
  test.beforeEach(async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto('/dashboard');
  });

  test('should render initial page content before async data loads', async ({ page }) => {
    // Intercept the async API call with delay
    await page.route('**/api/user-data', async (route) => {
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 2000));
      await route.abort();
      await route.continue();
    });

    // Alternative: intercept with delay and response
    await page.route('**/api/user-data', (route) => {
      setTimeout(() => {
        route.continue();
      }, 2000);
    });

    // Verify initial page skeleton/placeholder is immediately visible
    const pageTitle = page.getByRole('heading', { name: /Dashboard/i });
    await expect(pageTitle).toBeVisible();

    const loadingSkeleton = page.getByTestId('loading-skeleton');
    await expect(loadingSkeleton).toBeVisible();

    const mainContent = page.getByTestId('main-content');
    await expect(mainContent).toBeVisible();

    // Verify async data hasn't loaded yet
    const userProfile = page.getByTestId('user-profile');
    await expect(userProfile).not.toBeVisible();

    // Wait for async data to load
    await page.waitForResponse(response => 
      response.url().includes('/api/user-data') && response.status() === 200
    );

    // Verify async data is now loaded and displayed
    await expect(userProfile).toBeVisible();
    
    const usernameDisplay = page.getByTestId('username-display');
    await expect(usernameDisplay).toContainText('John Doe');

    const userEmail = page.getByTestId('user-email');
    await expect(userEmail).toContainText('john@example.com');

    await expect(loadingSkeleton).not.toBeVisible();
  });

  test('should handle async data fetch failure gracefully without blocking initial render', async ({ page }) => {
    // Intercept and abort the async API call
    await page.route('**/api/user-data', (route) => {
      route.abort('failed');
    });

    // Verify initial page content is still visible despite async failure
    const pageTitle = page.getByRole('heading', { name: /Dashboard/i });
    await expect(pageTitle).toBeVisible();

    const mainContent = page.getByTestId('main-content');
    await expect(mainContent).toBeVisible();

    // Wait briefly for async failure to be processed
    await page.waitForTimeout(1500);

    // Verify error state is displayed without blocking the page
    const errorMessage = page.getByTestId('error-message');
    await expect(errorMessage).toBeVisible();
    await expect(errorMessage).toContainText('Failed to load user data');

    // Verify page remains interactive after error
    const retryButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: /Retry/i });
    await expect(retryButton).toBeVisible();
    await expect(retryButton).toBeEnabled();

    // Click retry to verify interactivity
    await retryButton.click();

    // Verify page title is still visible and interactive
    await expect(pageTitle).toBeVisible();
  });
});</ASSISTANT>

test.describe('Multiple Concurrent API Calls Resolution', () => {

    await page.route('**/api/users', (route) => {
      route.abort();
    });
    await page.route('**/api/projects', (route) => {
      route.abort();
    });

    await expect(page.getByText(/Tasks/i)).toBeVisible();

    await expect(spinner).not.toBeVisible();
  });

      route.fulfill({ status: 200, body: JSON.stringify({ users: [] }) });

    await page.route('**/api/projects', (route) => {

    });

    await page.route('**/api/tasks', (route) => {
      route.fulfill({ status: 200, body: JSON.stringify({ tasks: [] }) });
    });

    const usersRequest = page.waitForResponse('**/api/users');
    const projectsRequest = page.waitForResponse('**/api/projects');
    const tasksRequest = page.waitForResponse('**/api/tasks');

    await page.getByRole('button', { name: /load dashboard/i }).click();

    await usersRequest;
    await projectsRequest;
    await tasksRequest;

    await expect(page.getByRole('status', { name: /failed to load projects/i })).toBeVisible();

    const projectsSection = page.locator('[data-testid="projects-section"]');
    await expect(projectsSection).not.toBeVisible();

    await expect(page.getByRole('region', { name: /users section/i })).toBeVisible();
    await expect(page.getByRole('region', { name: /tasks section/i })).toBeVisible();

    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: /retry/i })).toBeVisible();
    await page.getByRole('button', { name: /retry/i }).click();

    await expect(retrySpinner).toBeVisible();
  });

<SYSTEM>You are a senior QA automation engineer specialising in Playwright. Given a Jira user story, generate a complete, production-quality Playwright test script. Return ONLY the raw Playwright TypeScript — no markdown fences, no explanations. Use test.describe(), test.beforeEach(), at least 2 test() blocks. <USER>User story: "As a user, I want lazy-loaded components to appear smoothly without layout shift."
Category: async_await
Complexity: medium
Return the script only.</USER>
<ASSISTANT>import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

test.describe('Lazy-loaded components appear smoothly without layout shift', () => {
  test.beforeEach(async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto('/components');
  });

  test('should load lazy components smoothly with proper spacing', async ({ page }) => {
    // Set viewport for consistent testing
    await page.setViewportSize({ width: 1280, height: 720 });
    
    // Get initial container state with getByRole
    const container = page.getByRole('region', { name: 'lazy-component-container' });
    await expect(container).toBeVisible();
    
    // Wait for lazy load API and intercept it
    const lazyLoadPromise = page.waitForResponse(
      response => response.url().includes('/api/lazy-components') && response.status() === 200
    );
    
    // Scroll to trigger lazy load
    const scrollTrigger = page.getByTestId('scroll-trigger');
    await scrollTrigger.scrollIntoView();
    
    // Wait for API response
    await lazyLoadPromise;
    
    // Verify lazy-loaded cards are visible
    const card1 = page.getByTestId('lazy-card-1');
    const card2 = page.getByTestId('lazy-card-2');
    await expect(card1).toBeVisible();
    await expect(card2).toBeVisible();
    
    // Verify content has proper dimensions (no layout shift)
    const card1Box = await card1.boundingBox();
    expect(card1Box.height).toBeGreaterThan(100);
    expect(card1Box.height).toBeLessThan(500);
    
    // Verify placeholder is removed after content loads
    const skeleton = page.getByTestId('lazy-skeleton');
    await expect(skeleton).not.toBeVisible();
    
    // Verify smooth animation class is applied
    await expect(card1).toHaveClass(/fade-in-smooth/);
    
    // Verify text content loads with getByRole
    const cardContent = page.getByRole('heading', { name: /Loaded Content/ });
    await expect(cardContent).toBeVisible();
    
    // Additional assertion for text content
    await expect(card1).toContainText('Loaded Content');
  });

  test('should handle lazy load failure gracefully with fallback UI', async ({ page }) => {
    // Set viewport for consistent testing
    await page.setViewportSize({ width: 1280, height: 720 });
    
    // Intercept API to simulate failure
    await page.route('**/api/lazy-components', route => {
      route.abort('failed');
    });
    
    // Get scroll trigger with getByRole
    const scrollRegion = page.getByRole('region', { name: 'lazy-component-container' });
    await expect(scrollRegion).toBeVisible();
    
    // Scroll to trigger lazy load
    const scrollTrigger = page.getByTestId('scroll-trigger');
    await scrollTrigger.scrollIntoView();
    
    // Wait briefly for failed load attempt
    await page.waitForTimeout(500);
    
    // Verify error message is displayed
    const errorMessage = page.getByTestId('lazy-error-message');
    await expect(errorMessage).toBeVisible();
    await expect(errorMessage).toContainText('Failed to load');
    
    // Verify skeleton loaders are removed
    const skeleton = page.getByTestId('lazy-skeleton');
    await expect(skeleton).not.toBeVisible();
    
    // Verify retry button is available with getByRole
    const retryButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: /retry/i });
    await expect(retryButton).toBeVisible();
    await expect(retryButton).toBeEnabled();
    
    // Verify container maintains proper height to prevent layout shift
    const containerBox = await scrollRegion.boundingBox();
    expect(containerBox.height).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    
    // Setup successful response for retry
    await page.route('**/api/lazy-components', route => {
      route.continue();
    });
    
    // Intercept retry response
    const retryPromise = page.waitForResponse(
      response => response.url().includes('/api/lazy-components') && response.status() === 200
    );
    
    // Click retry button
    await retryButton.click();
    
    // Wait for retry response
    await retryPromise;
    
    // Verify content appears after retry
    const card1 = page.getByTestId('lazy-card-1');
    await expect(card1).toBeVisible();
    await expect(card1).toContainText('Loaded Content');
    
    // Verify error message is gone
    await expect(errorMessage).not.toBeVisible();
  });
});</ASSISTANT>

<USER>User story: "As a user, I want debounced search to trigger only after I stop typing for 300ms."
Category: async_await
Complexity: complex
Return the script only.</USER>
<ASSISTANT>import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

test.describe('Debounced Search Functionality', () => {
  test.beforeEach(async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto('/search');
  });

  test('should trigger search API call only after user stops typing for 300ms', async ({ page }) => {
    // Set up route interception for search API
    const searchRequests = [];
    await page.route('/api/search*', route => {
      searchRequests.push(route.request().url());
      route.continue();
    });

    // Get search input by role
    const searchInput = page.getByRole('textbox', { name: /search/i });
    await expect(searchInput).toBeVisible();

    // Type characters with delays less than 300ms (total ~200ms)
    await searchInput.fill('t');
    await page.waitForTimeout(50);
    await searchInput.fill('te');
    await page.waitForTimeout(50);
    await searchInput.fill('tes');
    await page.waitForTimeout(50);
    await searchInput.fill('test');
    await page.waitForTimeout(50);

    // Verify no API call has been made yet during typing
    expect(searchRequests).toHaveLength(0);

    // Wait for 300ms debounce timeout to elapse
    await page.waitForTimeout(350);

    // Now the API call should have been triggered
    expect(searchRequests.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(searchRequests[0]).toContain('q=test');

    // Verify search results are displayed
    const searchResults = page.getByRole('region', { name: /search results/i });
    await expect(searchResults).toBeVisible();

    // Verify result items are present
    const resultItems = page.locator('[data-testid="search-result-item"]');
    const count = await resultItems.count();
    expect(count).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  });

  test('should handle rapid consecutive searches and debounce correctly', async ({ page }) => {
    const searchRequests = [];
    await page.route('/api/search*', route => {
      searchRequests.push(route.request().url());
      route.continue();
    });

    // Get search input and clear button using role
    const searchInput = page.getByRole('textbox', { name: /search/i });
    await expect(searchInput).toBeVisible();

    const clearButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: /clear|reset/i });

    // First search: type and wait for debounce

<ASSISTANT>import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

test.describe('Search Race Condition Handling', () => {
  test.beforeEach(async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto('/search');
  });

  test('should display only the latest search result when multiple requests are in flight', async ({ page }) => {
    // Setup: intercept search API calls with delays to simulate race conditions
    await page.route('**/api/search*', async (route) => {
      const url = new URL(route.request().url());
      const query = url.searchParams.get('q');
      
      if (query === 'old') {
        await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 2000));
        await route.abort('timedout');
      } else if (query === 'new') {
        await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 500));
        await route.fulfill({
          status: 200,
          body: JSON.stringify({ results: [{ id: 2, title: 'New Search Result' }] })
        });
      }
    });

    // User performs rapid searches
    const searchInput = page.getByRole('searchbox', { name: /search/i });
    await searchInput.fill('old');
    await page.waitForTimeout(500);
    
    // Immediately search for new term before first response completes
    await searchInput.clear();
    await searchInput.fill('new');
    await page.waitForTimeout(1000);

    // Verify only the latest (new) result is displayed
    const searchResults = page.getByRole('region', { name: /results/i });
    await expect(searchResults).toBeVisible();
    
    const resultItems = page.getByRole('listitem');
    await expect(resultItems).toHaveCount(1);
    await expect(resultItems.first()).toContainText('New Search Result');
    await expect(resultItems.first()).not.toContainText('Old Search Result');
  });

  test('should handle stale results gracefully when search is cancelled before completion', async ({ page }) => {
    await page.route('**/api/search*', async (route) => {
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 3000));
      await route.abort('timedout');
    });

    // User starts typing
    const searchInput = page.getByRole('searchbox', { name: /search/i });
    await searchInput.fill('slo');
    await page.waitForTimeout(500);
    
    // User changes their mind and clears the search
    await searchInput.clear();
    const clearButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: /clear/i });
    await clearButton.click();

    // Wait a moment then verify no stale results appear
    await page.waitForTimeout(500);
    
    const searchResults = page.getByRole('region', { name: /results/i });
    await expect(searchResults).not.toBeVisible();
    
    const emptyState = page.getByText(/start typing to search/i);
    await expect(emptyState).toBeVisible();
  });
});</ASSISTANT>

Category: async_await

<ASSISTANT>import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

test.describe('Async Error Retry Functionality', () => {
  test.beforeEach(async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto('/async-operations');
  });

  test('should display retry option when async operation fails', async ({ page }) => {
    // Intercept the initial async request and simulate failure
    await page.route('**/api/async-operation', async (route) => {
      await route.abort('failed');
    });

    // Click button to trigger async operation using getByRole
    const operationButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: /start operation/i });
    await operationButton.click();

    // Wait for error message to appear
    const errorMessage = page.getByText(/operation failed/i);
    await expect(errorMessage).toBeVisible();

    // Verify retry button is visible using getByRole
    const retryButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: /retry/i });
    await expect(retryButton).toBeVisible();

    // Now allow the retry request to succeed
    await page.route('**/api/async-operation', async (route) => {
      await route.continue();
    });

    // Update mock to return success on retry
    await page.route('**/api/async-operation', async (route) => {
      await route.abort('succeeded');
    });

    // Click retry button
    await retryButton.click();

    // Verify success message is displayed
    const successMessage = page.getByText(/operation completed successfully/i);
    await expect(successMessage).toBeVisible();

    // Verify error message is no longer visible
    await expect(errorMessage).not.toBeVisible();
  });

  test('should handle multiple retry failures with eventual success', async ({ page }) => {
    let requestCount = 0;

    // Intercept requests with conditional logic
    await page.route('**/api/async-operation', async (route) => {
      requestCount++;
      if (requestCount < 3) {
        await route.abort('failed');
      } else {
        await route.continue();
      }
    });

    // Trigger initial operation using getByRole
    const operationButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: /start operation/i });
    await operationButton.click();

    // Verify first failure
    const errorMessage = page.getByText(/operation failed/i);
    await expect(errorMessage).toBeVisible();

    // Get retry button for first retry using getByRole
    let retryButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: /retry/i });
    await expect(retryButton).toBeVisible();
    await retryButton.click();

    // Verify error persists
    await expect(errorMessage).toBeVisible();

    // Get retry button for second retry
    retryButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: /retry/i });
    await expect(retryButton).toBeVisible();
    await retryButton.click();

    // Verify eventual success
    const successMessage = page.getByText(/operation completed successfully/i);
    await expect(successMessage).toBeVisible();

    // Verify error message is removed
    await expect(errorMessage).not.toBeVisible();
  });
});</ASSISTANT>

Category: async_await

<ASSISTANT>import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

test.describe('Long-running Task Persistence Across Page Refreshes', () => {
  test.beforeEach(async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto('/tasks');
  });

  test('should persist task progress when page is refreshed during execution', async ({ page }) => {
    // Start a long-running task using role-based selectors
    const startButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: /start task/i });
    await startButton.click();

    const taskNameInput = page.getByLabel(/task name/i);
    await taskNameInput.fill('ProcessData');

    const submitButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: /submit/i });
    await submitButton.click();

    // Verify task has started
    const taskStatus = page.getByRole('status');
    await expect(taskStatus).toContainText('Running');

    const progressIndicator = page.getByRole('progressbar');
    await expect(progressIndicator).toBeVisible();

    // Intercept the task status API call
    await page.route('**/api/tasks/status/*', route => route.continue());

    // Get the task ID before refresh
    const taskIdElement = page.getByText(/task id:/i);
    const taskIdText = await taskIdElement.textContent();
    const taskId = taskIdText.split(':')[1].trim();

    // Refresh the page mid-execution
    await page.reload();

    // Verify page loads and task list is present
    const taskList = page.getByRole('region', { name: /task list/i });
    await expect(taskList).toBeVisible();

    // Verify task persists with same ID after reload
    const restoredTaskId = page.getByText(taskId);
    await expect(restoredTaskId).toBeVisible();

    const restoredStatus = page.getByRole('status');
    await expect(restoredStatus).toContainText('Running');

    const restoredProgress = page.getByRole('progressbar');
    await expect(restoredProgress).toBeVisible();

    // Wait for task completion
    await expect(restoredStatus).toContainText('Completed', { timeout: 30000 });

    const taskResult = page.getByRole('region', { name: /result/i });
    await expect(taskResult).toBeVisible();
  });

  test('should handle missing task data gracefully when session storage is corrupted', async ({ page }) => {
    // Start a task using role-based selectors
    const startButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: /start task/i });
    await startButton.click();

    const taskNameInput = page.getByLabel(/task name/i);
    await taskNameInput.fill('CorruptedTask');

    const submitButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: /submit/i });
    await submitButton.click();

    // Verify task started
    const taskStatus = page.getByRole('status');
    await expect(taskStatus).toContainText('Running');

    // Corrupt the local/session storage
    await page.evaluate(() => {
      sessionStorage.clear();
      localStorage.clear();
    });

    // Mock API to simulate task not found
    await page.route('**/api/tasks/status/*', route => {
      route.abort('failed');
    });

    // Refresh page with corrupted storage
    await page.reload();

    // Verify appropriate error message is shown
    const errorMessage = page.getByRole('alert');
    await expect(errorMessage).toBeVisible();
    await expect(errorMessage).toContainText(/could not be restored|not found/i);

    // Verify user can start a new task instead
    const newStartButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: /start task/i });
    await expect(newStartButton).toBeVisible();
    await newStartButton.click();

    const newTaskInput = page.getByLabel(/task name/i);
    await newTaskInput.fill('NewTask');

    const newSubmitButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: /submit/i });
    await newSubmitButton.click();

    const newTaskStatus = page.getByRole('status');
    await expect(newTaskStatus).toContainText('Running');
  });
});</ASSISTANT>

Category: async_await

<ASSISTANT>import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

test.describe('Async State Preservation During Browser Navigation', () => {
  test.beforeEach(async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto('/dashboard');
  });

  test('should preserve async state when navigating between pages', async ({ page }) => {
    // Verify loading spinner is visible initially
    const loadingSpinner = page.getByTestId('loading-spinner');
    await expect(loadingSpinner).toBeVisible();

    // Wait for async user profile data to load
    await page.waitForResponse(response => 
      response.url().includes('/api/user-profile') && response.status() === 200
    );

    // Verify async state data is loaded and visible
    const userName = page.getByTestId('user-name');
    await expect(userName).toContainText('John Doe');
    
    const userStatus = page.getByTestId('user-status');
    await expect(userStatus).toContainText('Active');

    // Navigate to settings page using role-based locator
    const settingsButton = page.getByRole('link', { name: /settings/i });
    await settingsButton.click();
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/settings/);

    // Navigate back to dashboard using role-based locator
    const dashboardButton = page.getByRole('link', { name: /dashboard/i });
    await dashboardButton.click();
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/dashboard/);

    // Verify async state is preserved after navigation
    await expect(userName).toContainText('John Doe');
    await expect(userStatus).toContainText('Active');
    await expect(loadingSpinner).not.toBeVisible();
  });

  test('should handle async state preservation when network request fails', async ({ page }) => {
    // Intercept and fail the user profile API request
    await page.route('/api/user-profile', route => 
      route.abort('failed')
    );

    // Reload to trigger the failed request
    await page.reload();

    // Verify error message is displayed
    const errorMessage = page.getByTestId('error-message');
    await expect(errorMessage).toContainText('Failed to load profile');

    // Verify user data is not displayed
    const userName = page.getByTestId('user-name');
    await expect(userName).not.toBeVisible();

    // Navigate away using accessible button
    const settingsLink = page.getByRole('button', { name: /go to settings/i });
    await settingsLink.click();
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/settings/);

    // Navigate back to dashboard
    const backButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: /back to dashboard/i });
    await backButton.click();
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/dashboard/);

    // Verify error state is preserved after navigation
    await expect(errorMessage).toContainText('Failed to load profile');
    
    const loadingSpinner = page.getByTestId('loading-spinner');
    await expect(loadingSpinner).not.toBeVisible();
  });
});</ASSISTANT>

<ASSISTANT>import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

test.describe('Animated Transitions Between Async Page Loads', () => {
  test.beforeEach(async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto('/pages');
  });

  test('should display animated transitions when loading pages asynchronously', async ({ page }) => {
    // Verify initial page is visible
    const pageContainer = page.getByRole('main');
    await expect(pageContainer).toBeVisible();

    const pageTitle = page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Pages' });
    await expect(pageTitle).toBeVisible();

    // Set up listener for async page load API
    await page.route('**/api/pages/details/*', async (route) => {
      await route.continue();
    });

    // Click navigation link to trigger async load
    const navLink = page.getByRole('link', { name: 'About' });
    await navLink.click();

    // Verify loading animation appears
    const loadingSpinner = page.getByRole('status', { name: /loading/i });
    await expect(loadingSpinner).toBeVisible();

    // Wait for page content to load
    await page.waitForSelector('[data-testid="page-content"]');

    // Verify loading animation disappears
    await expect(loadingSpinner).not.toBeVisible();

    // Verify new page content is visible with animation class
    const pageContent = page.locator('[data-testid="page-content"]');
    await expect(pageContent).toBeVisible();
    
    const contentClass = await pageContent.getAttribute('class');
    expect(contentClass).toContain('fade-in');

    // Verify page title updated
    const updatedTitle = page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'About' });
    await expect(updatedTitle).toBeVisible();

    // Verify animation completes (opacity should be 1)
    const computedOpacity = await pageContent.evaluate((el) => window.getComputedStyle(el).opacity);
    expect(parseFloat(computedOpacity)).toBe(1);
  });

  test('should handle animation during failed async page loads gracefully', async ({ page }) => {
    // Set up route to simulate API failure
    await page.route('**/api/pages/details/*', async (route) => {
      await route.abort('failed');
    });

    // Click navigation link to trigger load
    const navLink = page.getByRole('link', { name: 'Contact' });
    await navLink.click();

    // Verify loading animation appears
    const loadingSpinner = page.getByRole('status', { name: /loading/i });
    await expect(loadingSpinner).toBeVisible();

    // Wait for error state
    await page.waitForSelector('[data-testid="error-message"]');

    // Verify loading animation disappears
    await expect(loadingSpinner).not.toBeVisible();

    // Verify error message is displayed with animation
    const errorMessage = page.getByText(/failed to load page/i);
    await expect(errorMessage).toBeVisible();
    
    const errorElement = page.locator('[data-testid="error-message"]');
    const errorClass = await errorElement.getAttribute('class');
    expect(errorClass).toContain('fade-in');

    // Verify previous page content remains visible as fallback
    const pageContent = page.locator('[data-testid="page-content"]');
    await expect(pageContent).toBeVisible();

    // Verify retry button is available
    const retryButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Retry' });
    await expect(retryButton).toBeVisible();
    await expect(retryButton).toBeEnabled();

    // Set up successful route and retry
    await page.route('**/api/pages/details/*', async (route) => {
      await route.continue();
    });
    
    await retryButton.click();
    
    // Verify loading animation appears again
    await expect(loadingSpinner).toBeVisible();
    
    // Wait for successful load
    await page.waitForSelector('[data-testid="page-content"]');
  });
});</ASSISTANT>

<ASSISTANT>import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

test.describe('Async Form Submission - Submit Button Disabled State', () => {
  test.beforeEach(async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto('/form-submission');
  });

  test('should disable submit button during form submission and re-enable after success', async ({ page }) => {
    // Setup API route interception
    await page.route('**/api/submit-form', (route) => {
      // Simulate network delay
      setTimeout(() => {
        route.continue();
      }, 1000);
    });

    // Fill form fields using getByLabel for accessibility
    const nameInput = page.getByLabel('Full Name');
    const emailInput = page.getByLabel('Email Address');
    const messageInput = page.getByLabel('Message');

    await nameInput.fill('John Doe');
    await emailInput.fill('john@example.com');
    await messageInput.fill('This is a test message');

    // Verify submit button is enabled before submission
    const submitButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: /submit/i });
    await expect(submitButton).toBeVisible();
    await expect(submitButton).not.toBeDisabled();

    // Click submit button and wait for network response
    const responsePromise = page.waitForResponse('**/api/submit-form');
    await submitButton.click();

    // Verify button is disabled during submission
    await expect(submitButton).toBeDisabled();

    // Wait for response
    const response = await responsePromise;
    expect(response.status()).toBe(200);

    // Verify button is re-enabled after successful submission
    await expect(submitButton).not.toBeDisabled();

    // Verify success message appears using getByRole
    const successMessage = page.getByRole('status');
    await expect(successMessage).toBeVisible();
    await expect(successMessage).toContainText('Form submitted successfully');

    // Verify form is cleared
    await expect(nameInput).toHaveValue('');
  });

  test('should disable submit button during submission and re-enable on API error', async ({ page }) => {
    // Setup API route to return error
    await page.route('**/api/submit-form', (route) => {
      route.abort('failed');
    });

    // Fill form with minimal data
    const nameInput = page.getByLabel('Full Name');
    const emailInput = page.getByLabel('Email Address');

    await nameInput.fill('Jane Doe');
    await emailInput.fill('jane@example.com');

    // Get submit button using getByRole
    const submitButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: /submit/i });

    // Click submit button
    await submitButton.click();

    // Verify button is disabled during submission
    await expect(submitButton).toBeDisabled();

    // Wait briefly for error state to settle
    await page.waitForTimeout(500);

    // Verify button is re-enabled after error
    await expect(submitButton).not.toBeDisabled();

    // Verify error message appears using getByRole alert
    const errorMessage = page.getByRole('alert');
    await expect(errorMessage).toBeVisible();
    await expect(errorMessage).toContainText('An error occurred');

    // Verify form data is preserved for retry
    await expect(nameInput).toHaveValue('Jane Doe');
  });
});</ASSISTANT>

<ASSISTANT>import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

test.describe('Delete Record Confirmation Modal', () => {
  test.beforeEach(async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto('/records');
  });

  test('should display confirmation modal and delete record when user confirms deletion', async ({ page }) => {
    // Arrange: Verify record row is visible
    const recordRow = page.locator('[data-testid="record-row-1"]');
    await expect(recordRow).toBeVisible();

    // Act: Click the delete button to open the confirmation modal
    const deleteButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: /delete/i });
    await deleteButton.first().click();

    // Assert: Confirmation modal should appear with title and message
    const confirmationModal = page.locator('[data-testid="confirmation-modal"]');
    await expect(confirmationModal).toBeVisible();

    const modalTitle = page.getByRole('heading', { name: /confirm delete/i });
    await expect(modalTitle).toBeVisible();

    const modalMessage = page.locator('[data-testid="modal-message"]');
    await expect(modalMessage).toContainText('Are you sure you want to delete this record?');

    // Assert: Action buttons should be visible
    const confirmButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: /confirm/i });
    const cancelButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: /cancel/i });
    await expect(confirmButton).toBeVisible();
    await expect(cancelButton).toBeVisible();

    // Intercept the DELETE API call
    await page.route('**/api/records/1', async (route) => {
      if (route.request().method() === 'DELETE') {
        await route.continue();
      }
    });

    // Act: Click the confirm delete button
    await confirmButton.click();

    // Assert: Modal should disappear
    await expect(confirmationModal).not.toBeVisible();

    // Assert: Record row should be removed from the list
    await expect(recordRow).not.toBeVisible();

    // Assert: Success message should be displayed
    const successMessage = page.locator('[data-testid="success-message"]');
    await expect(successMessage).toContainText('Record deleted successfully');
  });

  test('should close modal without deleting when user cancels deletion', async ({ page }) => {
    // Arrange: Verify record row exists
    const recordRow = page.locator('[data-testid="record-row-2"]');
    await expect(recordRow).toBeVisible();

    // Act: Click the delete button to open the confirmation modal
    const deleteButtons = page.getByRole('button', { name: /delete/i });
    await deleteButtons.nth(1).click();

    // Assert: Confirmation modal should appear
    const confirmationModal = page.locator('[data-testid="confirmation-modal"]');
    await expect(confirmationModal).toBeVisible();

    const modalTitle = page.getByRole('heading', { name: /confirm delete/i });
    await expect(modalTitle).toBeVisible();

    // Assert: Both action buttons should be visible
    const confirmButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: /confirm/i });
    const cancelButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: /cancel/i });
    await expect(confirmButton).toBeVisible();
    await expect(cancelButton).toBeVisible();

    // Act: Click the cancel button
    await cancelButton.click();

    // Assert: Modal should disappear
    await expect(confirmationModal).not.toBeVisible();

    // Assert: Record should still exist in the list
    await expect(recordRow).toBeVisible();

    // Assert: No success message should appear
    const successMessage = page.locator('[data-testid="success-message"]');
    await expect(successMessage).not.toBeVisible();
  });
});</ASSISTANT>

<USER>User story: "As a user, I want to close a modal by pressing the Escape key."
Category: modal_dialog

Return the script only.</USER>
<ASSISTANT>import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

test.describe('Modal Escape Key Closure', () => {
  test.beforeEach(async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto('/modal-page');
  });

  test('should close modal when Escape key is pressed', async ({ page }) => {
    // Open the modal using getByRole (first usage)
    const openButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Open Modal' });
    await openButton.click();
    
    // Verify modal is visible
    const modalDialog = page.locator('[data-testid="modal-dialog"]');
    await expect(modalDialog).toBeVisible();
    
    const modalTitle = page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Modal Dialog' });
    await expect(modalTitle).toBeVisible();
    
    // Press Escape key
    await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
    
    // Verify modal is closed
    await expect(modalDialog).not.toBeVisible();
    
    // Verify focus returns to trigger button (second getByRole usage)
    const focusedElement = page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Open Modal' });
    await expect(focusedElement).toBeFocused();
  });

  test('should not close modal when Escape is disabled and other keys are pressed', async ({ page }) => {
    // Open non-escapable modal
    const nonEscapableButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Open Non-Escapable Modal' });
    await nonEscapableButton.click();
    
    // Verify modal is visible
    const nonEscapableModal = page.locator('[data-testid="non-escapable-modal"]');
    await expect(nonEscapableModal).toBeVisible();
    
    // Verify warning text is present
    const warningText = page.getByText('This modal cannot be closed with Escape');
    await expect(warningText).toBeVisible();
    
    // Press Escape key
    await page.keyboard.press('Escape');
    
    // Verify modal is still visible after Escape
    await expect(nonEscapableModal).toBeVisible();
    
    // Close via explicit close button instead
    const closeButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Close' });
    await closeButton.click();
    
    // Verify modal is closed
    await expect(nonEscapableModal).not.toBeVisible();
  });
});</ASSISTANT>

test.describe('Table Row Numbers Feature', () => {
  test.beforeEach(async ({ page }) => {

    const dataTable = page.getByRole('table');
    await expect(dataTable).toBeVisible();

    // Verify the header shows row number column

    await expect(headerRowNumber).toBeVisible();

    // Verify first row displays row number 1
    const firstRowCell = page.locator('[data-testid="table-row-1"] [data-testid="row-number-cell"]');
    await expect(firstRowCell).toBeVisible();
    await expect(firstRowCell).toContainText('1');

    // Verify second row displays row number 2
    const secondRowCell = page.locator('[data-testid="table-row-2"] [data-testid="row-number-cell"]');
    await expect(secondRowCell).toBeVisible();
    await expect(secondRowCell).toContainText('2');

    // Verify third row displays row number 3
    const thirdRowCell = page.locator('[data-testid="table-row-3"] [data-testid="row-number-cell"]');
    await expect(thirdRowCell).toBeVisible();
    await expect(thirdRowCell).toContainText('3');

    // Verify all row number cells are visible
    const allRowNumberCells = page.locator('[data-testid="row-number-cell"]');
    const count = await allRowNumberCells.count();
    expect(count).toBeGreaterThan(0);

    // Intercept and verify API call for table data refresh
    await page.route('GET', '/api/table/data', async (route) => {
      await route.continue();
    });

    const refreshButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: /refresh/i });
    await refreshButton.click();

    // Verify row numbers persist after refresh
    await expect(firstRowCell).toContainText('1');
  });

  test('should handle row numbers correctly when table is empty or has single row', async ({ page }) => {
    // Mock empty table response
    await page.route('GET', '/api/table/data', (route) => {
      route.abort();
    });

    const refreshButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: /refresh/i });
    await refreshButton.click();

    // Verify row number column header still exists
    const headerRowNumber = page.getByRole('columnheader', { name: '#' });
    await expect(headerRowNumber).toBeVisible();

    // Verify no row number cells exist when table has no data
    const rowNumberCells = page.locator('[data-testid="row-number-cell"]');
    await expect(rowNumberCells).toHaveCount(0);

    // Mock single row response
    await page.route('GET', '/api/table/data', (route) => {
      route.fulfill({
        status: 200,
        contentType: 'application/json',
        body: JSON.stringify({ rows: [{ id: 1, name: 'Test Item' }] })
      });
    });

    await refreshButton.click();

    // Verify single row displays number 1
    const singleRowCell = page.locator('[data-testid="table-row-1"] [data-testid="row-number-cell"]');
    await expect(singleRowCell).toBeVisible();
    await expect(singleRowCell).toContainText('1');

    // Verify only one row number cell exists
    const allRowCells = page.locator('[data-testid="row-number-cell"]');
    await expect(allRowCells).toHaveCount(1);
  });
});</ASSISTANT>

test.describe('Right-click Context Menu on Table Row', () => {
  test.beforeEach(async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto('/table');
  });

  test('should display context menu when right-clicking a table row', async ({ page }) => {
    // Wait for table to load
    await page.waitForSelector('[data-testid="table-row-1"]');

    // Get the first table row using role-based locator
    const tableRow = page.getByRole('row').first();

    await expect(contextMenu).toBeVisible();

    // Verify Edit option is visible and clickable
    const editOption = page.getByRole('menuitem', { name: /edit/i });
    await expect(editOption).toBeVisible();

    // Verify Delete option is visible
    const deleteOption = page.getByRole('menuitem', { name: /delete/i });
    await expect(deleteOption).toBeVisible();

    // Verify Duplicate option is visible
    const duplicateOption = page.getByRole('menuitem', { name: /duplicate/i });
    await expect(duplicateOption).toBeVisible();

    // Click Edit option and verify menu closes
    await editOption.click();
    await expect(contextMenu).not.toBeVisible();
  });

  test('should close context menu when pressing Escape or clicking elsewhere', async ({ page }) => {
    // Wait for table to load
    await page.waitForSelector('[data-testid="table-row-2"]');

    // Get a table row and verify it exists
    const tableRow = page.getByRole('row').nth(1);
    await expect(tableRow).toBeVisible();

    await expect(contextMenu).toBeVisible();

    await expect(contextMenu).not.toBeVisible();

    await expect(contextMenu).toBeVisible();

    // Click on table container (outside the menu) to close it

    // Verify context menu is closed

Category: table_list

<ASSISTANT>import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

test.describe('Table Row Highlight on Hover', () => {
  test.beforeEach(async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto('/table');
  });

  test('should highlight a row when user hovers over it', async ({ page }) => {
    // Get the table row element
    const tableRow = page.getByRole('row', { name: /row 1/i });
    await expect(tableRow).toBeVisible();
    
    // Verify initial state - row should not have highlight class
    await expect(tableRow).not.toHaveClass(/row-highlighted/);
    
    // Hover over the row
    await tableRow.hover();
    
    // Assert that the row is now highlighted with the correct class
    await expect(tableRow).toHaveClass(/row-highlighted/);
    
    // Verify the background color changed
    const bgColor = await tableRow.evaluate((el) => window.getComputedStyle(el).backgroundColor);
    expect(bgColor).not.toBe('rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');
    
    // Move mouse away by hovering on another element
    const otherElement = page.getByRole('heading', { name: /table/i });
    await otherElement.hover();
    
    // Assert highlight is removed
    await expect(tableRow).not.toHaveClass(/row-highlighted/);
  });

  test('should not highlight rows when table is empty or disabled', async ({ page }) => {
    // Navigate to empty table view
    const emptyButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: /empty table/i });
    await emptyButton.click();
    
    // Verify no rows exist in the table
    const tableRow = page.getByRole('row', { name: /row 1/i });
    await expect(tableRow).not.toBeVisible();
    
    // Navigate back to table with disabled state
    const tableButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: /show table/i });
    await tableButton.click();
    
    const disableButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: /disable table/i });
    await disableButton.click();
    
    // Get the disabled row
    const disabledRow = page.getByRole('row', { name: /row 1/i });
    
    // Attempt to hover over disabled row
    await disabledRow.hover();
    
    // Assert highlight class is not applied and row remains disabled
    await expect(disabledRow).toBeDisabled();
    await expect(disabledRow).not.toHaveClass(/row-highlighted/);
    
    // Verify opacity reflects disabled state
    const opacity = await disabledRow.evaluate((el) => window.getComputedStyle(el).opacity);
    expect(parseFloat(opacity)).toBeLessThan(1);
  });
});</ASSISTANT>

test.describe('Table Row Selection Highlighting', () => {
  test.beforeEach(async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto('/table');
  });

  test('should highlight selected rows with a different background color', async ({ page }) => {
    // Verify table is visible using getByRole
    const table = page.getByRole('table');
    await expect(table).toBeVisible();
    
    // Get all table rows
    const rows = page.locator('[data-testid="table-row"]');
    const rowCount = await rows.count();
    expect(rowCount).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    
    // Click first row to select it using getByRole
    const firstRow = rows.first();
    await firstRow.click();
    
    // Verify first row has highlight class
    await expect(firstRow).toHaveClass(/row-selected/);
    
    // Verify highlight color is applied
    const bgColor = await firstRow.evaluate((el) => 
      window.getComputedStyle(el).backgroundColor
    );
    expect(bgColor).not.toBe('rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');
    
    // Click second row to select it
    const secondRow = rows.nth(1);
    await secondRow.click();
    
    // Verify second row is now highlighted
    await expect(secondRow).toHaveClass(/row-selected/);
    
    // Verify first row remains highlighted (multi-select scenario)
    await expect(firstRow).toHaveClass(/row-selected/);
    
    // Verify both rows have the same highlight color
    const secondBgColor = await secondRow.evaluate((el) => 
      window.getComputedStyle(el).backgroundColor
    );
    expect(bgColor).toBe(secondBgColor);
  });

  test('should remove highlight when deselecting a row', async ({ page }) => {
    // Select a row
    const rows = page.locator('[data-testid="table-row"]');
    const firstRow = rows.first();
    await firstRow.click();
    await expect(firstRow).toHaveClass(/row-selected/);
    
    // Get the original background color before selection from an unselected row
    const unselectedRow = rows.nth(2);
    const unselectedColor = await unselectedRow.evaluate((el) => 
      window.getComputedStyle(el).backgroundColor
    );
    
    // Click the selected row again to deselect it
    await firstRow.click();
    
    // Verify row no longer has highlight class
    await expect(firstRow).not.toHaveClass(/row-selected/);
    
    // Verify background color reverts to default
    const revertedColor = await firstRow.evaluate((el) => 
      window.getComputedStyle(el).backgroundColor
    );
    expect(revertedColor).toBe(unselectedColor);
    
    // Click select-all checkbox using getByRole
    const selectAllCheckbox = page.getByRole('checkbox', { name: /select all/i });
    await selectAllCheckbox.click();
    
    // Verify all rows are highlighted
    const allRows = await rows.all();
    for (const row of allRows) {
      await expect(row).toHaveClass(/row-selected/);
    }
    
    // Click clear-selection button using getByRole
    const clearButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: /clear selection/i });
    await clearButton.click();
    
    // Verify no rows are highlighted
    for (const row of allRows) {
      await expect(row).not.toHaveClass(/row-selected/);
    }
  });
});</ASSISTANT>

Category: table_list

<ASSISTANT>import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

test.describe('Virtual Scroll List - 10,000 Rows Performance', () => {
  test.beforeEach(async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto('/virtual-scroll-list');
  });

  test('Happy Path: Should render virtual scroll list with 10,000 rows without lag', async ({ page }) => {
    // Verify the list container is visible using getByRole
    const container = page.getByRole('region', { name: /virtual scroll/i });
    await expect(container).toBeVisible();

    // Verify initial rows are rendered using getByRole
    const rows = page.getByRole('row', { name: /row/i });
    const rowCount = await rows.count();
    expect(rowCount).toBeGreaterThan(0);

    // Intercept API call to fetch initial data
    await page.route('/api/rows?limit=50&offset=0', async (route) => {
      await route.continue();
    });

    // Verify row content is displayed
    const firstRow = rows.first();
    await expect(firstRow).toContainText('Row');

    // Scroll down to middle of list
    await container.evaluate((el) => {
      el.scrollTop = el.scrollHeight / 2;
    });

    // Wait for lazy-loaded rows to appear
    await page.waitForTimeout(500);

    // Verify rows are still rendered without lag
    const visibleRows = page.getByRole('row', { name: /row/i });
    const visibleCount = await visibleRows.count();
    expect(visibleCount).toBeGreaterThan(0);

    // Scroll to bottom
    await container.evaluate((el) => {
      el.scrollTop = el.scrollHeight;
    });

    // Wait for final rows to load
    await page.waitForTimeout(500);

    // Verify final rows are rendered
    const lastRow = rows.last();
    await expect(lastRow).toBeVisible();

    // Verify row count indicator shows correct total
    const totalCount = page.getByText(/total.*10000/i);
    await expect(totalCount).toBeVisible();

    // Verify no error messages appear
    const errorMsg = page.getByRole('alert', { name: /error/i });
    await expect(errorMsg).not.toBeVisible();
  });

  test('Negative Path: Should handle scroll performance degradation and display error gracefully', async ({ page }) => {
    // Verify the list container is visible using getByRole
    const container = page.getByRole('region', { name: /virtual scroll/i });
    await expect(container).toBeVisible();

    // Simulate API timeout/failure
    await page.route('/api/rows?limit=50&offset=*', async (route) => {
      await route.abort('timedout');
    });

    // Attempt to scroll
    await container.evaluate((el) => {
      el.scrollTop = el.scrollHeight / 2;
    });

    // Wait for error handling
    await page.waitForTimeout(1000);

    // Verify error message is displayed using getByRole
    const errorAlert = page.getByRole('alert');
    await expect(errorAlert).toBeVisible();
    await expect(errorAlert).toContainText('Unable to load data');

    // Verify retry button is available
    const retryButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: /retry/i });
    await expect(retryButton).toBeVisible();
    await retryButton.click();

    // Restore API and allow successful retry
    await page.unroute('/api/rows?limit=50&offset=*');
    await page.route('/api/rows?limit=50&offset=*', async (route) => {
      await route.continue();
    });

    // Wait for retry to complete
    await page.waitForTimeout(1000);

    // Verify error message is cleared
    await expect(errorAlert).not.toBeVisible();

    // Verify list is restored using getByRole
    const rows = page.getByRole('row', { name: /row/i });
    const rowCount = await rows.count();
    expect(rowCount).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  });
});</ASSISTANT>

test.describe('Loading States Accessibility - Assistive Technology', () => {
  test.beforeEach(async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto('/loading-states');
  });

  test('should communicate loading state to screen readers with aria-busy and aria-label', async ({ page }) => {
    // Setup: Intercept the API call that triggers loading
    await page.route('**/api/data/fetch', route => {
      // Simulate delay to observe loading state
      setTimeout(() => {
        route.continue();
      }, 2000);
    });

    // Find and click the button that initiates data loading using getByRole
    const loadButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: /load data/i });
    await expect(loadButton).toBeVisible();
    await loadButton.click();

    await expect(loadingContainer).toHaveAttribute('aria-busy', 'true');
    await expect(loadingContainer).toHaveAttribute('aria-label');
    
    const ariaLabel = await loadingContainer.getAttribute('aria-label');
    expect(ariaLabel).toContain('Loading');

    // Verify spinner element has proper ARIA attributes for screen readers
    const spinner = page.locator('[data-testid="spinner"]');
    await expect(spinner).toHaveAttribute('role', 'status');
    await expect(spinner).toHaveAttribute('aria-live', 'polite');
    await expect(spinner).toContainText('Loading in progress');

    // Wait for loading to complete
    await page.waitForLoadState('networkidle');

    // Verify loading state is removed after completion
    await expect(loadingContainer).toHaveAttribute('aria-busy', 'false');

    // Verify completion message is announced with assertive live region
    const statusMessage = page.locator('[data-testid="status-message"]');
    await expect(statusMessage).toHaveAttribute('aria-live', 'assertive');
    await expect(statusMessage).toContainText('Data loaded successfully');

    // Verify content is now visible using getByRole as second required instance
    const loadedContent = page.getByRole('region', { name: /loaded content/i });
    await expect(loadedContent).toBeVisible();
  });

  test('should handle loading failure and communicate error state to screen readers', async ({ page }) => {
    // Setup: Intercept API call to simulate failure
    await page.route('**/api/data/fetch', route => {
      route.abort('failed');
    });

    // Click button to initiate loading using getByRole
    const loadButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: /load data/i });
    await expect(loadButton).toBeVisible();
    await loadButton.click();

    // Verify initial loading state with aria-busy
    const loadingContainer = page.locator('[data-testid="loading-container"]');
    await expect(loadingContainer).toHaveAttribute('aria-busy', 'true');

    // Wait for error state to appear
    await page.waitForTimeout(2000);

    // Verify loading state is cleared
    await expect(loadingContainer).toHaveAttribute('aria-busy', 'false');

    // Verify error state is announced with proper ARIA attributes for assistive technology
    const errorMessage = page.locator('[data-testid="error-message"]');
    await expect(errorMessage).toBeVisible();
    await expect(errorMessage).toHaveAttribute('role', 'alert');
    await expect(errorMessage).toHaveAttribute('aria-live', 'assertive');
    await expect(errorMessage).toContainText('Failed to load data');

    const retryButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: /retry/i });
    await expect(retryButton).toBeVisible();
    await expect(retryButton).not.toBeDisabled();

    const spinner = page.locator('[data-testid="spinner"]');
    await expect(spinner).not.toBeVisible();
  });
});</ASSISTANT>

test.describe('Product Image Pinch-to-Zoom Functionality', () => {
