  });

  test('should zoom in on product image with pinch gesture', async ({ page }) => {
    // Locate and verify product image is visible using getByRole
    const productImage = page.getByRole('img', { name: /product image/i });
    await expect(productImage).toBeVisible();

    // Get initial transform state
    const initialTransform = await productImage.evaluate(el => 
      window.getComputedStyle(el).transform
    );

    // Simulate pinch-to-zoom gesture on the image
    await productImage.dispatchEvent('touchstart', {
      detail: {
        touches: [
          { clientX: 100, clientY: 100 },
          { clientX: 200, clientY: 200 }
        ]
      }
    });

    await productImage.dispatchEvent('touchmove', {
      detail: {
        touches: [
          { clientX: 80, clientY: 80 },
          { clientX: 220, clientY: 220 }
        ]
      }
    });

    await productImage.dispatchEvent('touchend', {
      detail: {
        touches: []
      }
    });

    // Verify image is still visible after zoom
    await expect(productImage).toBeVisible();

    // Locate and verify zoom reset button is visible using getByRole
    const zoomResetButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: /reset zoom/i });
    await expect(zoomResetButton).toBeVisible();

    // Verify the transform has changed from initial state
    const finalTransform = await productImage.evaluate(el =>
      window.getComputedStyle(el).transform
    );
    expect(finalTransform).not.toBe(initialTransform);
  });

  test('should not zoom beyond maximum scale and handle edge case gracefully', async ({ page }) => {
    // Locate product image and verify visibility
    const productImage = page.getByRole('img', { name: /product image/i });
    await expect(productImage).toBeVisible();

    // Simulate multiple consecutive pinch gestures to attempt exceeding max zoom
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
      await productImage.dispatchEvent('touchstart', {
        detail: {
          touches: [
            { clientX: 100, clientY: 100 },
            { clientX: 150, clientY: 150 }
          ]
        }
      });

      await productImage.dispatchEvent('touchmove', {
        detail: {
          touches: [
            { clientX: 50, clientY: 50 },
            { clientX: 250, clientY: 250 }
          ]
        }
      });

      await productImage.dispatchEvent('touchend', {
        detail: {
          touches: []
        }
      });
    }

    // Verify image is still visible and hasn't broken
    await expect(productImage).toBeVisible();

    // Locate and verify zoom level display using getByLabel
    const zoomLevelDisplay = page.getByLabel(/zoom level/i);

  });

<ASSISTANT>import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

test.describe('Order Confirmation After Successful Payment', () => {
  test.beforeEach(async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto('/checkout');
  });

  test('should display order confirmation with details after successful payment', async ({ page }) => {
    // Fill in payment form using getByLabel and getByRole
    const cardNumberInput = page.getByLabel('Card Number');
    await cardNumberInput.fill('4111111111111111');

    const expiryInput = page.getByLabel('Expiry Date');
    await expiryInput.fill('12/25');

    const cvvInput = page.getByLabel('CVV');
    await cvvInput.fill('123');

    const cardholderInput = page.getByLabel('Cardholder Name');
    await cardholderInput.fill('John Doe');

    // Intercept payment API call
    await page.route('**/api/payments/process', (route) => {
      route.abort('blockedbyresponse');
    });

    await page.route('**/api/payments/process', (route) => {
      route.continue({
        status: 200,
        contentType: 'application/json',
        body: JSON.stringify({
          success: true,
          orderId: 'ORD-123456',
          transactionId: 'TXN-789012',
          amount: 99.99,
          currency: 'USD',
        }),
      });
    });

    // Submit payment using getByRole
    const payButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: /pay now/i });
    await payButton.click();

    // Verify confirmation page is displayed
    const confirmationHeading = page.getByRole('heading', { name: /order confirmed/i });
    await expect(confirmationHeading).toBeVisible();

    // Verify order ID is displayed
    const orderIdElement = page.getByText('ORD-123456');
    await expect(orderIdElement).toBeVisible();

    // Verify transaction ID is displayed
    const transactionIdElement = page.getByText('TXN-789012');
    await expect(transactionIdElement).toBeVisible();

    // Verify amount is displayed
    const amountElement = page.getByText('$99.99');
    await expect(amountElement).toBeVisible();

    // Verify confirmation email is shown
    const emailElement = page.getByText(/john@example.com/);
    await expect(emailElement).toBeVisible();

    // Verify download invoice button is visible
    const downloadButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: /download invoice/i });
    await expect(downloadButton).toBeVisible();

    // Verify continue shopping button is visible
    const continueButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: /continue shopping/i });
    await expect(continueButton).toBeVisible();
  });

  test('should handle payment failure and display error message without confirmation', async ({ page }) => {
    // Fill in invalid payment form using getByLabel
    const cardNumberInput = page.getByLabel('Card Number');
    await cardNumberInput.fill('4000000000000002');

    const expiryInput = page.getByLabel('Expiry Date');
    await expiryInput.fill('12/25');

    const cvvInput = page.getByLabel('CVV');
    await cvvInput.fill('123');

    const cardholderInput = page.getByLabel('Cardholder Name');
    await cardholderInput.fill('Jane Doe');

    // Intercept failed payment API call
    await page.route('**/api/payments/process', (route) => {
      route.continue({
        status: 402,
        contentType: 'application/json',
        body: JSON.stringify({
          success: false,
          error: 'Card declined',
          errorCode: 'CARD_DECLINED',
        }),
      });
    });

    // Submit payment using getByRole
    const payButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: /pay now/i });
    await payButton.click();

    // Verify confirmation page is NOT displayed
    const confirmationHeading = page.getByRole('heading', { name: /order confirmed/i });
    await expect(confirmationHeading).not.toBeVisible();

    // Verify error message is shown
    const errorMessage = page.getByText('Card declined');
    await expect(errorMessage).toBeVisible();

    // Verify we remain on checkout page
    const checkoutPayButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: /pay now/i });
    await expect(checkoutPayButton).toBeVisible();

    // Verify card number is preserved for retry
    const cardInput = page.getByLabel('Card Number');
    await expect(cardInput).toHaveValue('4000000000000002');
  });
});</ASSISTANT>

<ASSISTANT>import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

test.describe('Payment Loading State', () => {
  test.beforeEach(async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto('/checkout');
  });

  test('should display loading state while payment is processing', async ({ page }) => {
    await page.getByLabel('Card Number').fill('4111111111111111');
    await page.getByLabel('Expiry Date').fill('12/25');
    await page.getByLabel('CVC').fill('123');
    await page.getByLabel('Cardholder Name').fill('John Doe');

    await page.route('**/api/payments/process', (route) => {
      setTimeout(() => {
        route.continue();
      }, 2000);
    });
    
    await submitButton.click();
    
    const loadingSpinner = page.getByRole('status', { name: /processing/i });
    await expect(loadingSpinner).toBeVisible();
    
    const loadingText = page.getByText('Processing your payment');
    await expect(loadingText).toBeVisible();
    
    await expect(submitButton).toBeDisabled();
    
    await page.waitForURL(/.*order-confirmation.*/);
    
    await expect(loadingSpinner).not.toBeVisible();
    
    const successMessage = page.getByRole('status', { name: /successful/i });
    await expect(successMessage).toBeVisible();
    await expect(successMessage).toContainText('Payment successful');
  });

  test('should handle payment processing timeout and display error state', async ({ page }) => {
    await page.getByLabel('Card Number').fill('5555555555554444');
    await page.getByLabel('Expiry Date').fill('06/26');
    await page.getByLabel('CVC').fill('456');
    await page.getByLabel('Cardholder Name').fill('Jane Smith');
    
    await page.route('**/api/payments/process', (route) => {
      route.abort('timedout');
    });
    
    const submitButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Pay Now' });
    await submitButton.click();
    
    const loadingSpinner = page.getByRole('status', { name: /processing/i });
    await expect(loadingSpinner).toBeVisible();
    
    await page.waitForTimeout(3000);
    
    await expect(loadingSpinner).not.toBeVisible();
    
    const errorMessage = page.getByRole('alert');
    await expect(errorMessage).toBeVisible();
    await expect(errorMessage).toContainText('Payment processing failed');
    
    await expect(submitButton).not.toBeDisabled();
    
    const retryButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Try Again' });
    await expect(retryButton).toBeVisible();
  });
});</ASSISTANT>

test.describe('Checkout Form - Card Expiry Validation (MM/YY Format)', () => {
  test.beforeEach(async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto('/checkout');
  });

  test('should accept valid card expiry in MM/YY format and proceed to payment', async ({ page }) => {
    // Fill in card holder name using getByLabel
    const cardholderLabel = page.getByLabel('Cardholder Name');
    await cardholderLabel.fill('John Doe');

    // Fill in card number using getByLabel

    // Fill in CVV using getByLabel
    const cvvLabel = page.getByLabel('CVV');
    await cvvLabel.fill('123');

    // Set up listener for payment API call
    const paymentPromise = page.waitForResponse(response =>
      response.url().includes('/api/payments/process') && response.status() === 200
    );

    // Click submit button using getByRole
    const submitButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: /submit payment|pay now/i });
    await submitButton.click();

    // Wait for payment API response
    const response = await paymentPromise;
    expect(response.status()).toBe(200);

    // Verify success message is visible
    const successMessage = page.getByText(/payment successful/i);
    await expect(successMessage).toBeVisible();

    // Verify redirect to order confirmation
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/order-confirmation/);
  });

  test('should reject invalid card expiry formats and display error message', async ({ page }) => {
    // Fill in card holder name using getByLabel
    const cardholderLabel = page.getByLabel('Cardholder Name');
    await cardholderLabel.fill('Jane Smith');

    // Fill in card number using getByLabel
    const cardNumberLabel = page.getByLabel('Card Number');
    await cardNumberLabel.fill('4532015112830366');

    // Fill in invalid expiry date (wrong format - YY/MM instead of MM/YY)
    const expiryInput = page.getByPlaceholder('MM/YY');
    await expiryInput.fill('25/12');

    // Fill in CVV using getByLabel
    const cvvLabel = page.getByLabel('CVV');
    await cvvLabel.fill('456');

    // Click submit button using getByRole
    const submitButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: /submit payment|pay now/i });
    await submitButton.click();

    // Verify error message is displayed for invalid expiry format

    await expect(expiryError).toBeVisible();

    // Verify payment was not processed (success message should not exist)

    await expect(successMessage).not.toBeVisible();

    // Verify user is still on checkout page
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/checkout/);
  });

test.describe('Payment Flow - Total Price Update on Quantity Change', () => {
  test.beforeEach(async ({ page }) => {
    await page.goto('/cart');
  });

  test('should update total price when quantity is increased', async ({ page }) => {
    // Verify initial product is visible
    const productItem = page.getByRole('article', { name: /product/i });
    await expect(productItem).toBeVisible();

    // Get quantity input and verify initial value
    const quantityInput = page.getByLabel('Quantity');

      route.continue();
    });

    // Increase quantity
    await quantityInput.fill('3');
    const updateBtn = page.getByRole('button', { name: /update quantity/i });
    await updateBtn.click();

    // Wait for network to be idle
    await page.waitForLoadState('networkidle');

    // Verify total price is updated
    await expect(totalPrice).toContainText('$30.00');
    const subtotal = page.getByText('Subtotal');
    await expect(subtotal).toContainText('$30.00');

    // Locate quantity input by label
    const quantityInput = page.getByLabel('Quantity');
    await expect(quantityInput).toBeVisible();

    await quantityInput.fill('-5');

    // Verify input is reverted to previous valid value
    await expect(quantityInput).toHaveValue('1');
  });
});</ASSISTANT>

test.describe('Payment Timeout Error Page Redirect', () => {
  test.beforeEach(async ({ page }) => {

  });

  test('should redirect to error page when payment times out', async ({ page }) => {
    // Setup route to simulate timeout
    await page.route('**/api/v1/payment/process', (route) => {
      setTimeout(() => {
        route.abort('timedout');
      }, 35000);
    });

    // User fills in payment details using accessible locators
    const cardNumberInput = page.getByLabel('Card Number');
    await cardNumberInput.fill('4242424242424242');
    expect(cardNumberInput).toBeVisible();

    const cardExpiryInput = page.getByLabel('Expiry Date');
    await cardExpiryInput.fill('12/25');
    expect(cardExpiryInput).toBeVisible();

    const cvvInput = page.getByLabel('CVV');
    await cvvInput.fill('123');

    const cardholderInput = page.getByLabel('Cardholder Name');
    await cardholderInput.fill('John Doe');

    // User submits payment
    const payButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Pay Now' });
    await payButton.click();
    expect(payButton).toBeVisible();

    // Wait for timeout and redirect
    await page.waitForNavigation();

    // Assert redirect to error page
    expect(page).toHaveURL(/.*payment-error/);
    
    const errorTitle = page.getByRole('heading', { name: /timeout/i });
    await expect(errorTitle).toBeVisible();

    const errorMessage = page.getByText(/payment processing timed out/i);
    await expect(errorMessage).toBeVisible();

    const retryButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: /retry/i });
    await expect(retryButton).toBeVisible();
  });

  test('should display timeout error and allow retry when payment network fails', async ({ page }) => {
    // Setup route to simulate network failure
    await page.route('**/api/v1/payment/process', (route) => {
      route.abort('failed');
    });

    // User enters payment information using accessible selectors
    const cardNumberField = page.getByLabel('Card Number');
    await cardNumberField.fill('5555555555554444');
    expect(cardNumberField).toBeVisible();

    const expiryField = page.getByLabel('Expiry Date');
    await expiryField.fill('06/26');
    expect(expiryField).toBeVisible();

    const cvvField = page.getByLabel('CVV');
    await cvvField.fill('456');

    const nameField = page.getByLabel('Cardholder Name');
    await nameField.fill('Jane Smith');

    // User submits payment
    const submitButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Complete Purchase' });
    await submitButton.click();

    // Wait for error page navigation
    await page.waitForNavigation();

    // Verify error page is displayed
    expect(page).toHaveURL(/.*payment-error/);

    const errorHeading = page.getByRole('heading', { name: /payment failed/i });
    await expect(errorHeading).toBeVisible();

    const errorDetails = page.getByText(/connection timeout/i);
    await expect(errorDetails).toBeVisible();

    // Verify retry and navigation buttons are present
